name: Sanya Chauhan
title: Masters of Business Analytics Candidate '24
bio: Sanya Chauhan is a passionate Woman in Tech currently pursuing a Master of Business Analytics at the . She is particularly excited about the potential of Extended Reality (XR) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to shape the future, and how these technologies can be used to create positive change in the world. MIT Sloan School of Management Sanya's academic background lies in statistics with her bachelor’s degree from in India, and she has actively explored machine learning, business analytics, and data science through coursework and internships at Fortune 500 companies in the Finance and Tech Industry. Her experience includes working in GenAI, natural language processing, and machine learning. Saya has recently concluded a project with Schneider Electric and is currently involved in projects with Liberty Mutual Insurance and Bangkok Bank. Lady Shri Ram College At MIT, Sanya has continued to delve into analytics, AI, and their applications. Her enthusiasm for technology extends beyond her academic pursuits. She is actively involved in the MIT Sloan community, serving as the Corporate Relations Manager for the , and being an active part of clubs like Sloan Women in Management and the Tech Club. Sanya enjoys participating in tech and business competitions. In the past, she has secured top positions in Ernst & Young’s Next Generation Women Competition, Google x MIT Product Hackathon and more! Analytics Career Night Sanya is excited to manage external relations for HarvardXR Conference 2024 and be a part to facilitate discussions about XR shaping the future of work!
